title: AdminAiFallbackTestCallCallableResponse
description: What one live test call did, by step: the federation params (config), the Google identity token (token_mint), the Anthropic token exchange (token_exchange), the Messages call (messages_call), the structured output (schema), or the monthly cap and daily test limit (budget). Never a token, a prompt or a model answer.

refusal.description: Why the budget step refused, when failedStep is budget.

costMicros.description: What the call settled to against the AI fallback's monthly cap (micro-dollars).
